# HTML CSS fixture design system

## 1. Visual Theme & Atmosphere

Quiet enterprise surfaces with restrained emphasis.

## 2. Color System

Use the project custom properties from tokens.css.

## 3. Typography

Use the project display and body roles.

## 4. Spacing & Layout

Use the shared card spacing rhythm.

## 5. Component Principles

Prefer reusable block, element and modifier classes.

## 6. Component Stylings

Cards and primary actions are defined by the project CSS catalog.

## 7. Motion & Interaction

Keep motion minimal and functional.

## 8. Do's and Don'ts

Do use tokens and reusable classes. Do not add page-local palettes.

## 9. Agent Prompt Guide

Reuse indexed project roles and variants before creating a new pattern.
